scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev -w apps/backend" "npm run dev -w apps/dashboard"
scripts.dev:crm: concurrently "npm run dev -w apps/crm-api" "npm run dev -w apps/crm-web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/backend && npm run build -w apps/dashboard
scripts.build:crm: npm run build -w apps/crm-api && npm run build -w apps/crm-web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w apps/backend && npm run lint -w apps/dashboard
scripts.lint:crm: npm run lint -w apps/crm-api && npm run lint -w apps/crm-web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w apps/backend && npm run typecheck -w apps/dashboard
scripts.typecheck:crm: npm run typecheck -w apps/crm-api && npm run typecheck -w apps/crm-web
scripts.test: npm run test -w apps/backend && npm run typecheck -w apps/backend && npm run typecheck -w apps/dashboard
